tokens.name: linen
tokens.usage: Shared family ground, LINEN #F1EFE7 — matches the shop banner's textured cream. Page background.

tokens.name: black
tokens.usage: Shared family BLACK #101010 — the line-drawing ink of the badge and florals. Body text on linen.

tokens.name: plum
tokens.usage: PLUM #4E3555, sampled from the deep violet roses in the floral letters. Headings, footer bands, the dark accent. 9.3:1 with linen.

tokens.name: rose
tokens.usage: ROSE #B5344F, a deepened version of the pink-red roses (sampled #C23F57, darkened to pass 4.5:1). Prices, sale tags, links, buttons. 5.1:1 on linen.

tokens.name: blush
tokens.usage: BLUSH #DEC2C0 from the pale pink petals. Soft fills, tag backgrounds, photo mats; text on it is `black` or `plum`.

tokens.name: mauve
tokens.usage: MAUVE #79666E from the dusty lavender blooms. Secondary text and meta lines on linen (4.6:1).

tokens.name: peacock-blue
tokens.usage: Family thread: PEACOCK BLUE #016795. Use only for a tiny "a Cook Consulting Services brand" link or footer detail.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Product cards and panels on `surface`.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Body and heading text on `surface` and `surface-raised`.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Item details, captions and meta on `surface` and `surface-raised`.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Links, prices, primary buttons on `surface`.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text on an `accent` fill.

tokens.name: accent-deep
tokens.usage: Headings with color, footer bands, the second button style.

tokens.name: rule
tokens.usage: The fine line of the oval badge: 1px frames and dividers.

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: Quiet card borders (decorative).

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring, 2px solid, offset 2px.

styles.name: display
styles.sample: made by hand, one bloom at a time
styles.usage: Hero and shop announcement lines, lowercase League Spartan — the family voice.

styles.name: script
styles.usage: Signature accents only — "jules studio", "thank you", a name on a gift tag. Echoes the badge's handwritten script. Never for sentences.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Each letter is built from silk roses, peonies and hydrangea, arranged by hand in Dallas, Texas.
styles.usage: Listing descriptions and policies, Quicksand Regular.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: The badge's tracked uppercase line. League Spartan Regular, UPPERCASE, very wide tracking.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Hairline offsets; gap between a label and its rule.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inline gaps, icon-to-text, tight stacks.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Paragraph spacing; padding inside small blocks.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card and panel padding; gutter between photos.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Gap between sections inside a page.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Page margins and the width of the side label rail (brand-book frame).

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Default for every block, photo, button and panel. The family is square-cornered.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Form fields and small chips only, to soften a hard pixel edge.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Pills, discs and the oval badge shape. Use sparingly.

tokens.name: border-hairline
tokens.usage: Section rules and frames, as in the brand book's grid.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Focus rings and emphasized rules.
